notes: the only avian & exotic hospital in Nassau; serves all of NYC (Manhattan, Queens, Brooklyn, Bronx, Staten Island) plus Westchester/NJ/CT. Treats birds, reptiles, parrots, sugar gliders, rabbits, chinchillas and other small mammals; offers endoscopy, anesthesia, minimally invasive surgery, emergency services, MEDICAL BOARDING and grooming (birdexoticsvet.com). A strong exotics-only option for outer-borough/LI residents.
